import sys

D = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"


def main():
    n, b = map(int, sys.stdin.read().split())
    p = 1
    while p * b <= n:
        p *= b
    s = []
    while p >= 1:
        d = 0
        while n >= p:
            n -= p
            d += 1
        s.append(D[d])
        p //= b
    print(int("".join(reversed(s)), b))


main()
